elements.notes: Same position/pattern as back buttons on other screens.
"Manual Drive" title, centered, same y-band as other screens' titles.
Large white card containing the 5 mode tiles and the 3 intensity buttons.
Unselected mode tile: bucket/mop icon, gray "Sweep & Mop" label.

SELECTED mode tile: solid blue border, a small blue checkmark badge in the top-right corner, water-drop icon, bold black "Water Suction" label. Slightly larger footprint than the unselected tiles because the selection border adds to the measured bounding box.
Unselected mode tile: vacuum icon, gray "Sweep & Vacuum" label.
Unselected mode tile, but with a BLACK (not gray) "Sweep & Push" label - the label color does not follow the selected/unselected pattern of the other tiles (see unknowns).
Unselected mode tile, also with a BLACK "Sweep" label like tile_sweep_push. Rightmost tile.
Unselected intensity button: gray fill, bold black "Gentle" label.
SELECTED intensity button: blue border, light-blue-tinted fill, bold black "Standard" label.
Unselected intensity button: gray fill, bold black "Powerful" label.
Full-width blue gradient button, bold white "Start Cleaning" label, below and outside main_card. Extends a few px wider than main_card on both sides (main_card: x=20-940; this button: x=15-946).

relationships.notes: 158-163px each - approximately equal, small variance likely from the selected tile's border adding to its measured box

the measured gap between successive tiles increases left-to-right (13, 15, 18, 21px) - this may be real or may be measurement variance from the selected tile's border; flagged rather than asserted as intentional

both start at x=81/49 respectively - not exactly aligned to each other, but button_gentle (81) sits roughly under the gap between tile_sweep_mop and tile_water_suction, not under either tile's left edge

unknowns: Why tile_sweep_push and tile_sweep use BLACK labels while tile_sweep_mop and tile_sweep_vacuum use GRAY labels, despite all four being equally 'unselected' - this may indicate a different disabled/enabled state, a different capability tier, or simply be a rendering inconsistency in the reference; not resolvable from the image alone.
Whether the increasing horizontal gap between mode tiles (13/15/18/21px) is an intentional layout choice or measurement noise.
Exact corner radius of the tiles, intensity buttons, main_card, and button_start_cleaning.

Why button_start_cleaning's bounding box (x=15-946) is a few pixels wider than main_card's (x=20-940) directly above it - whether this is a deliberate design choice or measurement/antialiasing variance.
The selection-indicator pattern (checkmark badge) - only observed on tile_water_suction; whether other selection states use the same badge could not be confirmed from a single screenshot.
